top_signal.title: Online Accounting
top_signal.summary: Looking for updated reviews or recommendations for online or remote accounting like Collective, lettuce, etc. (the last post on here seemed to be a few years ago).    Background, I'm currently under a partnership LLC my wife and I formed a few years ago. Thanks to a recent layoff, I'm now working on my own and luckily doing pretty well to start. I need to either change my current LLC or form a new one, figure out my tax strategy for this year, and would like to be ready for S-corp election next year.    I'm not sure if something like collective to could help solve my problem, but a few local CPAs I talked to are very expensive. ($4k / year for just returns and probably another $2-4k for planning, strategy, LLC formations... and wouldn't even include book keeping and payroll). I'd love to work with someone local but I also don't want to pay $10k+/year against a +/- $250k revenue.       submitted by     /u/OrangeArch       [link]       [comments]
